CA.rationale: No attention/processing allocation claim linking to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red) and a separate organization/access field (origin) are both explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim tied to an identified content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify grid cell sets and associate them with color attributes (e.g., red) at current timepoints.

D.rationale: Content (color cell set) and a distinct organization/access field (origin) are both present for the same content referent/time.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/organization fields describe how content entries are derived/presented (copied_prior_record, inherited_current, command_estimate, etc.).
